case_number: 2024 INSC 986; SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRIMINAL) NO.2819 OF 2024; WRIT PETITION (CRIMINAL) NO.168 OF 2024

parties.respondent: National Investigation Agency; Union of India & ANR.

summary: Bail cancellation under NDPS Act post-NIA jurisdiction transfer; 500kg heroin smuggling across Gujarat-Punjab border; custodial interrogation necessity under UAPA s.17, s.18; NIA jurisdiction upheld over NDPS-UAPA nexus; challenge to s.6(5), s.8 NIA Act upheld; Sections 21(c), 25, 27A NDPS Act charges; disclosure statement recoveries admissible.
legal_provisions_cited: National Investigation Agency Act, 2008 s.6(5), s.6(2), s.8
final_judgment: Special Leave Petition dismissed; Writ Petition dismissed; bail cancellation and NIA jurisdiction upheld.
